disclaimer.title: Ethical Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: SIPOP is a scientific governance and oversight program. We do not provide ghostwriting services, data fabrication, or guaranteed publication. Our role is to audit methodology, enhance statistical integrity, and ensure compliance with international reporting standards (PRISMA, CONSORT, GRADE). All final intellectual and ethical responsibilities remain with the authors.

home.title: SIPOP - Scientific Integrity and Publication Oversight Program
home.description: SIPOP helps researchers improve methodological rigor, statistical validity, and publication trustworthiness of biomedical research.

hero.title: Guiding research from uncertainty to credibility
hero.subtitle: The Scientific Integrity and Publication Oversight Program (SIPOP) helps researchers improve the methodological rigor, statistical validity, and publication trustworthiness of their biomedical research.

about.title: About
about.body: The Scientific Integrity and Publication Oversight Program ensures rigorous, transparent, and ethical research practices in biomedical sciences. Our mission is to elevate research standards by providing thorough review and guidance, minimizing bias, and fostering credibility in scientific publications.

items.quote: Before SIPOP, my biggest challenge was finding someone who truly understood network meta-analysis. I couldn't find anyone to answer my questions — or a statistician willing to commit to my study. SIPOP gave me peace of mind. And for someone in the final stretch of a PhD, that's worth everything.

hero.title: Publications

cta.title: Your research could be next.
cta.body: SIPOP supports researchers at every stage — from protocol design to pre-submission audit — so your work reaches the journals it deserves.

technicalReview.title: Technical Review
technicalReview.description: Get an independent expert evaluation of your manuscript before submission. SIPOP's Technical Review covers methodology, language, formatting, and competitive positioning.

hero.subtitle:
Most manuscripts aren't rejected for lack of scientific quality.
They're rejected because the work wasn't prepared for the scrutiny of the evaluator.

withoutItems: Years of work buried by avoidable flaws
withItems: Expert evaluation before the editor sees it

what.title: Every detail evaluated
what.intro: Being technically correct is the baseline. High-impact journals look for something harder to fake: Strategic Coherence — the alignment between your question, your design, and your analysis, from the very first paragraph.

cards.title: Methodology
cards.body: Analysis validity, bias identification, instrument alignment, and sampling adequacy.

cards.title: Language
cards.body: Scientific writing quality, active voice preference, vocabulary precision, and dialect adequacy for your target journal.

cards.title: Formatting
cards.body: Paragraph structure, section length, and editorial compliance with international reporting standards.

cards.title: Competitive Positioning
cards.body: Innovation assessment, literature saturation, and relevance for the journal you're targeting.

cards.title: Content Coherence
cards.body: Capacity to answer its own research question, data grounding, and literature alignment.

cards.title: International Standards
cards.body: Compliance with PRISMA, CONSORT, STROBE, GRADE, and other applicable guidelines.
